source: Public Solana getTransaction (jsonParsed, maxSupportedTransactionVersion 1) bodies fetched read-only on 2026-10-08 from the recorder default RPC host for signatures taken from a scratch copy of the PAPER tape journal. Public on-chain data; no account or runtime data.
purpose: Decoder regression evidence for reversed PumpSwap pools whose wrapped SOL cash account is closed inside the swap transaction.

bodies.name: tweetcraft_base_decimals
bodies.note: Reversed PumpSwap pool (base WSOL, quote TWEETCRAFT). One SELL instruction; the user wrapped SOL account is created and closed in the transaction, so it has no pre/post token balance. Journal classification before this change: unclassified BASE_DECIMALS_OR_MINT_MISSING.

logMessages: Program log: Initialize the associated token account

bodies.name: shitcoin_base_decimals
bodies.note: Reversed PumpSwap pool (base WSOL, quote SHITCOIN). Two swap instructions by two wallets (SELL then BUY) with closed wrapped SOL accounts. Journal classification before this change: unclassified BASE_DECIMALS_OR_MINT_MISSING; the pool yielded zero decoded swaps in 4,898 bodies.

bodies.note: Reversed PumpSwap pool decoded by the default path because the user wrapped SOL account kept pre/post balances. journal_event is the event the live recorder stored for this signature.

bodies.note: Normal orientation (base CLAUDIA, quote WSOL). The user wrapped SOL quote account is closed in the transaction and has no balance entry; the default path tolerates that on the quote side.
